stable.headline: One Boolean card with five styles, Photo mode as a studio render, Decimate that keeps closer to the shape, new scene tabs that open at once, and 9 fixes.
notes: One Boolean card: Union, Subtract, Intersect, Without and Split, with their options
Photo mode as a studio render: contact shadow, a glossy floor, backdrop and studio lights
Decimate keeps closer to the shape, in a third of the time (meshoptimizer 1.3)
Profile and Round: several points moved at once; Make solid takes an axis
New scene tabs open at once
9 fixes: Decimate Within on curved parts, Intersect with several parts, the Photo mode floor
